initialization: Same Qwen3-1.7B base, same union SID vocabulary and random seed; no Beauty adapter
training_loss: Domain-specific legal-prefix SID SFT, shared backbone, no auxiliary grounding objective
checkpoint_rule: Single-domain runs maximize own-domain tuning NDCG@10; joint runs maximize the arithmetic mean of both domain tuning NDCG@10. Same selected checkpoint supplies all audit metrics; retain the initial model as a fallback.
primary_comparison: Own-domain single models versus shared joint models on 768 fixed development users per domain; report each domain, macro mean, user-paired bootstrap, realized sample and token counts and wall time
budget_scope: Equal optimizer steps and sampled records, not exactly equal tokens or per-domain exposure. Report per-domain exposure explicitly; do not attribute every single-vs-joint gap to interference.
stage_policy: No scientific changes within 800-step small stages. Finish the four baseline runs before the large-stage decision on our method; only clear engineering failures interrupt a run.
resource_policy: Only free authorized GPU5/6, one run per card, no idle reservations, finite queue
evidence_scope: Single-seed development baseline study on public MiniOneRec data; not a reproduction of its published full-parameter SFT/RL system and not final-test results
